title: Adaptivecaps
description: Use any image as your Minecraft cape with vanilla-style cape animations and an integrated editor.
body:
# AdaptiveCaps
Click Import Cape and select any image from your device. The editor will automatically convert it into a Minecraft-compatible cape, ready for preview and customization.


**AdaptiveCaps** is a cape customization mod for Minecraft Fabric that allows players to create, personalize, and display custom capes through a simple, modern, and optimized experience.

Built with performance and compatibility in mind, AdaptiveCaps features its own rendering system, allowing players to use custom capes without relying on external mods or third-party services.

## ✨ Features

* 🎨 Integrated in-game cape editor
* 🖌️ Painting tools with a full color palette
* 🖼️ Image import for automatic cape creation
* 📂 Support for PNG, JPG, JPEG, and GIF files
* 🎞️ Animated GIF cape support
* 🧩 Automatic conversion to Minecraft cape format
* 👀 Real-time cape preview before saving
* 🪶 Elytra compatibility
* ⚡ Optimized rendering for high performance
* 🔄 Automatic synchronization between players using the mod
* 🎮 Simple and intuitive user interface
* 🧹 Fast cape editing and updating system

## 🎞️ Animated Capes

AdaptiveCaps fully supports animated capes using GIF files. Animations are automatically processed and displayed to other players who have the mod installed, allowing you to create unique and dynamic capes within Minecraft.

## 🚀 Purpose

AdaptiveCaps was created to provide a complete cape customization experience, allowing any player to build their own visual identity in Minecraft quickly and easily.

Whether you prefer drawing pixel by pixel or importing your own artwork, AdaptiveCaps gives you the freedom to create a truly unique cape.

## 📦 Compatibility

* Fabric Loader/neoforge
* Minecraft 1.21+
* Compatible with most optimization mods

## ❤️ Acknowledgements

This project continues to evolve thanks to the support of the community and the players who help by testing new versions and providing valuable feedback.

**Create. Customize. Stand Out.**

**Your cape, your way.**

*The AdaptiveCaps Team*
